messages:
Nima Rao: hey team! Nima here — starting today on Platform infra, thrilled to be here. i'm south-bay hybrid, love brewing kombucha and bringing my stubborn little fiddle-leaf fig to the desk. any rookie plant or SCOBY tips? also — where's the kombucha tap located? :)
Ava Patel: welcome Nima!! :tada: Tap's in the kitchen fridge next to the espresso machine. pro tip: keep that fig away from direct AC blasts or it will sulk.
Luca: hi hi! fwiw, if you need a plant sitter for travel, ping #plant-swap — lots of volunteers. Also, i will fight anyone who underfeeds their SCOBY. DM me your brew schedule. :muscle:
Syd (People Ops): welcome!! i'm Syd — swing by People Ops for a welcome swag + badge pickup. i asked badge-bot to pre-create yours.
badge-bot: Badge created for Nima Rao. Desk: 3B-14. Access: Hybrid. Welcome packet ready in People Ops.
Juno: 3B-14 is by the rooftop plants — great spot. lunch at 12 today? small welcome walk + ramen run for the new hire energy? :ramen:
Nima Rao: love that. i'll bring a tiny jar of my raspberry batch for sampling (low alcohol, high enthusiasm). see you at 12. also, what’s the canonical coffee order here? i'm a 3-sugar latte kind of human.
Ava Patel: we have a very opinionated barista crew. order the 'house drip' if you're indecisive. cinnamon rolls pair well with excess sugar. :drooling_face:
Luca: pro safety reminder: kombucha spills are sticky. keep it on a coaster and away from keyboards. :sweat_smile:
Nima Rao: duly noted. thanks everyone — excited to meet y'all in person!
